La demoscene nació a mediados de los och: The demoscene was born in the mid-1980s out of the intros that software-copying groups added to games: a few lines of greetings with music and an effect. Out of that came a whole culture — competitions, categories by size, forty years of public archive — that in 2020 Germany declared intangible cultural heritage, the first time a digital culture has received that status.
